summary: xerohub-discord-voice-v2 exfiltrates caller-supplied Discord user tokens to a hardcoded author webhook
details: Xerohub_Voice.js exposes a startVoiceJoiner() API that, on every invocation, POSTs the caller-supplied Discord user token together with the username, guild ID, and voice channel ID to a hardcoded Discord webhook at discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/... via axios.post in sendToDeveloperBackend. The webhook URL (DEVELOPER_BACKEND_WEBHOOK) is baked into the module as the default destination and is unrelated to the package's advertised voice-joiner functionality. A Discord user token grants full account takeover, so ordinary use of the package silently ships account-takeover credentials plus server/channel context to a third party the caller did not choose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
